title: Write a sequential report
description: Implement write_report(records, path). records is a list of [name, score] pairs with unique names. Sort by name ascending and write name,score followed by a newline for every record, without a header. Return the number of records. You may use sorted() in this file-processing exercise.
hints: Open the output in write mode.
setup:
def check_report(records):
    count = write_report(records, 'out.csv')
    with open('out.csv') as f:
        return [count, f.read()]
